rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for an area where fruit trees are grown.

example.english: There are many orange trees in this orchard.
example.traditional: 呢片果園種咗好多橙樹。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin3 gwo2 jyun4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 caang2 syu6

rows.note: Use this when referring to the fruit trees themselves rather than the land they grow on.

example.english: These orchard trees produce a lot of fruit every year.
example.traditional: 呢啲果樹年年都結好多果。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gwo2 syu6 nin4 nin4 dou1 git3 hou2 do1 gwo2
